title: American Bankers Association: OCC’s GENIUS rules ‘undermine’ US Congress

title: Bloomberg enables scalable crypto asset exposure classification under Base framework
snippet: Bloomberg today announced that its Crypto Exposure Analytics now supports customers in assessing their compliance with the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision’s (BCBS) prudential standards for banks’ exposure to crypto assets and tokenized real-world assets.
